[size=2][b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]FEATURES[/font][/b]

[/size][size=2]♡ all grass is tillable
♡ fishing pond
♡ dedicated crop and animal areas
♡ configurable options
♡ berry bushes!


[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]INSTALL INSTRUCTIONS[/font][/b]

[/size][b]1.[/b] download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[b]2.[/b] extract the mod folder from the zip into Stardew Valley/Mods
[b]3. [/b]run game with SMAPI to generate config.json file in the mod's folder
[b]4.[/b] change the config options if you want; otherwise start a new save on the Riverland farm
[size=2]

[b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]CONFIG OPTIONS[/font][/b]

[/size][size=2]♡ "FarmToReplace": "Standard", "Forest", "Riverland", "Hilltop", "Wilderness" (default "Riverland")
[/size]♡ "Version:" "decorated" or "clean" (default "decorated")
